## Notes

Facepunch Studios, Garry Newman; Source engine mod released 2004-12-24; standalone on Steam 2006-11-29 (Valve); Windows, macOS, Linux; physics gun, tool gun welds and constraints; Lua addons; gamemodes TTT, Prop Hunt, DarkRP, Wiremod; 25.5 million sold by 2024.
